# Separated clay reclaim streams

Pale offcuts go into bin P and dark offcuts go into bin D. Unidentified offcuts go into bin X for disposition and are not reclaim feed. Use the scoop with the matching bin letter and keep each lid paired with its own bin.

Transfer material only within its own stream against a reclaim ticket. Record the source bin letter and preparation ticket on every transfer. There is no cross-stream transfer allowance. The [split decision](../records/decision-reclaim-split.md) gives the reason; the [common-bin sheet](reclaim-common-bin.md) is retired.
